name: oc-fe-check-jenkins-build
description: Check the latest Jenkins build of a branch (default dev); when it failed in the frontend stages (Checkout Front / Build Front), diagnose the log, fix opencell-portal under INTRD-22890 (local build must pass), open and merge the PR, then re-run the job with the failed build's parameters and watch the frontend stages. Fully automatic, one fix attempt per run. Jenkins via REST (JENKINS_USER + JENKINS_API_TOKEN), Bitbucket via REST.
